title: The Harlem Globetrotters: Rivalry Tour
seo_title: Harlem Globetrotters Rivalry Tour in Springfield, MO
description: The Harlem Globetrotters bring their 2027 Rivalry Tour to Great Southern Bank Arena, where they play the Washington Generals and a new lineup of rivals. Fans can be pulled onto the court, help decide the action, and appear on the jumbotron, and a free pre-game tip-off party starts when doors open at 6:00 PM. It is a sports and family event on Tuesday, March 16, 2027 at 7:00 PM at 901 S. National Ave. in Springfield, MO.
